verses.1: Let us go, O Lord, and seek Your help for our salvation.
verses.2: His face was turned toward us, in praise of the songs of Nari’loh.
verses.3: For Jehovah is a great God, and He is a great King over all gods.
verses.4: Who has the power to explore the lands and navigate through the mountains?
verses.5: To whom the sea belongs; and he created it, and his hands shaped it into its form.
verses.6: Let us bow and fall down, in worship before the LORD our God.
verses.7: For he is our God, and we are His people. Today, if you listen to Him, then you will be saved.
verses.8: Do not make it difficult for yourselves to forgive each other, as it is the right thing to do in times of conflict.
verses.9: Those who tried to tempt me, your ancestors did so in their sins. But they also saw my works.
verses.10: Forty years passed, and I said to them, “My people, they do not know the ways of God.”
verses.11: I will be happy if they come to my place of rest.
